integrity: The formula, column criterion, VC dimension and exchange obstruction are proved for all stated positive integers. Deterministic verifier is provided; no external audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: This is a complete result only for spanning-tree incidence on K_{3,n}, with a K_{2,n} boundary; it does not classify wider complete bipartite graphs. Historical priority under different terminology remains a risk. Finite enumeration corroborates but does not prove unrestricted statements.
title: Exact shattering polynomial and a matroid boundary for spanning trees of \(K_{3,n}\)
